# AlgoInsight

AlgoInsight is a lightweight DSA tracker, interview preparation workspace, and note-taking tool hosted on GitHub Pages.

## Key features
- DSA problem tracking with filters and progress insights
- Rich notes for interview preparation and concept revision
- Productivity tools (focus timer and sticky notes)
- Optional Google sign-in and sync support

## Important URLs
- Live app: https://bravitheja.github.io/DSA/
- Sitemap: https://bravitheja.github.io/DSA/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://bravitheja.github.io/DSA/robots.txt
- Repository: https://github.com/bravitheja/DSA

## Intended audience
Software engineers and students preparing for coding interviews and algorithm practice.
